build_multiagent_learner_set: build a SynchronousDecentralizedLearnerSet wrapping multiple agent learners with a custom separator
create_learner_step: create a learning step that advances all wrapped learners in the decentralized learner set
get_variables_from_learners: get named variables from sub-learners using prefixed names like learner-var with the separator
save_learner_set_state: save the state of all learners in the SynchronousDecentralizedLearnerSet into a SynchronousDecentralizedLearnerSetState
restore_learner_set_state: restore all learner states from a SynchronousDecentralizedLearnerSetState object back into the learner set
